description: This file is a PHP source code defining the 'Banner' controller class within the Opencart admin design namespace. It implements various methods for managing banner entities, including listing, editing, creating, and deleting banners for the OpenCart admin panel.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for managing banners in the OpenCart admin design namespace, extending the base Controller class and implementing CRUD and listing functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the banner list page, initializing language, setting page title, breadcrumbs, and rendering the banner list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to retrieve and respond with the list of banners, including sorting, pagination, and filtering.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches the list of banners from the model with sorting, ordering, and pagination applied, returning the data view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the banner creation/edit form, pre-filling data if editing an existing banner.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving banner data, including permission checks, validation, and redirecting upon success.
